title: Victorian Christmas village
description: A snowy Victorian Christmas village on an 840 x 420 mm base of 8 magnet-jointed tiles: a 263 mm one-piece church with its bell tower standing in front of the nave, hollowed for a puck light and with a hollow tower lit by a battery tea light through its lancet window and belfry louvres, plus an inn, bakery, cottages and houses for FDM, and a 160 mm tree, lamps, firs and figures for resin. Built with the scene workflow using Meshy meshes (1041 credits). The base tiles have been printed.
material: White PLA and resin, hand painted

components.name: Buildings: one-piece church with lit tower (v16), B3 house body and roof, bakery, inn, B1 and B6 cottages
components.printer: Bambu Lab H2D class (FDM, over 256 mm build height for the church)
